Volume 6: The Cave Campaign is the sixth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the third of four volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato. 

==Blurb==
Pokémon trainer Red has vanished! Yellow Caballero and Pikachu's search leads them to the mysterious headquarters of the Elite Four on Cerise Island. Who has the baddest Pokémon around? There's only one way to find out...!

And watch out for Team Rocket, Pikachu... Are they your enemies or your allies now?

==Trivia==
The number of Pokémon found includes her Snubbull and Lugia.
No chapters from this volume are included in the compilation volume The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow.
This was the last volume to be published in by Glénat.
The Message from Mato featured in this volume mentions there being a hint regarding what the future has in store for the manga after the release of hidden in the book. There are actually several:
In Weezing Winks Out, Koga passes Parlyz Heal to by sending him a Poké Ball with a Pokémon holding it, a mechanic introduced in Generation II.
In Victim of Venusaur, orders Saur to use , a move introduced in Generation II.
The Pokédex analysis at the end of the book lists as having seen 153 Pokémon species, despite Generation I featuring only 151.

===Errors===
====VIZ Media second edition====
On page 45, there is a blank word balloon.
On page 142, is called the "Earth-type".

===Translation edits===
====VIZ Media second edition====
The last two pages of the volume containing analyses of 's, 's and 's Pokédex are omitted.
In all of its appearances throughout the book, 's skin color is changed from black to gray in order to match its purple redesign following the Jynx controversy.
